column1:
1.  Agreement among pathologists for common disease, neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic
e.g.  reactive epithelial changes (from chronic gastritis) vs. adenocarcinoma
column2:
2.  Agreement among pathologists for distinguishing malignant vs. benign in common neoplasms
e.g.  tubular adenoma vs. adenocarcinoma in a colorectal polyp
column3:
3.  Agreement among pathologists for broad subtyping of common neoplastic disease
e.g.  adenocarcinoma vs. squamous cell carcinoma in a lung tumor
column4:
4.  Agreement among pathologists for detailed subtyping of common neoplastic diseases
e.g. papillary subtype vs. acinar subtype of lung adenocarcinoma
column5:
5.  Agreement among pathologists for broad subtyping of common non-neoplastic disease
e.g. H. pylori gastritis vs. autoimmune gastritis
column6:
6.  Agreement among pathologists for distinguishing malignant vs. benign in rare neoplastic diseases
e.g. schwannoma vs. MPNST
column7:
7.  Agreement among pathologists for subtyping of rare neoplastic entities
e.g. subtyping salivary gland tumors
column8:
8.  Agreement among pathologists for diagnosis of rare non-neoplastic disease
e.g.  interstitial pneumonia
